# dokploy_organizations (Data Source)

Fetches all organizations from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover organization IDs.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_organizations" "all" {}

# Output all organization IDs
output "organization_ids" {
  value = { for o in data.dokploy_organizations.all.organizations : o.name => o.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
